answer: Identities stop being free the moment each one must publish a verifiable unit of work. Only identities that keep producing auditable work arrive at the knoll of payment, so volume alone buys nothing. Written in a verbs first, step by step register, it stays short. The design leans on web-of-trust with decaying edges, unlocked only after continuous uptime. Each submission hangs on the saffron of a task receipt, and the signal is checked by a panel whose members never see the submitter.
